title: GTA VI Update 01.002.000 Rolls Out on PS5 and Xbox Ahead of Launch
description: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games has released a new pre-launch GTA VI update, 01.002.000, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. The outlet cites X accounts for rollout timing, affected files, and update sizes; official patch notes were not included in the report.
youtubeTitle: GTA VI Update 01.002.000 Rolls Out on PS5 and Xbox Ahead of Launch
socialHook: RockstarINTEL reports a new GTA VI pre-launch update, 01.002.000, is rolling out on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

sections.heading: What RockstarINTEL reported
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL reports that Rockstar Games released a new pre-launch update for Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The outlet says update 01.002.000 began appearing around midday UK time for some PS5 users who had already completed the initial pre-load, and that only about 50% of users received it initially, with the rest expected within the next 11 hours.

sections.heading: File details and platform timing
paragraphs: Citing @PlaystationSize, RockstarINTEL says the split rollout was expected to reach the remaining PS5 users by midnight UK time on November 14. Citing @iGrandTheftAuto, it reports the roughly 1GB PS5 update affects files labelled 'story000-[GameContent]' and 'Levels(americas)-0,' while the required PlayStation firmware remains 14.22.00.00. RockstarINTEL later added that an Xbox update went live around 4pm GMT and came in at about 2.2GB on Xbox Series X|S.

sections.heading: What remains unclear
paragraphs: RockstarINTEL does not publish official patch notes or a Rockstar/Take-Two statement in the item, so the exact fixes and whether another patch will arrive before launch remain unknown. The report also does not confirm whether the update is universal across all regions or accounts. Readers should treat the rollout details as the outlet's report, with the cited X accounts providing the size and file information.
